spec_case: core/compiler.py::_compile_prompt, issue #778's own step 5 (closes issue #507's own item 5)
description: A `multipleOf` divisor reached only through a `$ref` into a key no schema-structure walk recognizes as housing a subschema (`myCustomDefs` isn't a metaschema-recognized applicator) used to skip the metaschema check and reach Python's own runtime `%` arithmetic instead, raising `TypeError`. The new well-formedness check walks every `multipleOf` in the schema unconditionally, regardless of which key holds it, so this is now a compile-time refusal before any instance is considered, the same as a top-level one.
